name: SaveStatus
description: The line under a setting that applies at once. Render it whatever the setting's state, with `SaveStatusError` inside when the change failed and nothing inside otherwise: empty, it is hidden and takes no height. A `span` (shown as a block), like every ListRow part, so it stays valid inside a row's body; give it an `id` for the control's `aria-describedby`.

name: SaveStatusError
description: What failed. It is an alert, announced when it appears, and stays until the next change. Its line appears with it, so the setting grows by one line while it shows.

name: SaveStatusSaved
deprecated:
A setting that applies at once no longer says "Saved": the
control showing its new value is the confirmation (Forms, settings that
apply at once). Renders nothing, whatever its children, so its
`SaveStatus` stays empty and takes no height. Leave it out: render
`SaveStatusError` when the change failed and nothing otherwise.
